name: Neverin (Germany)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Neverin (a white tower with a half-timbered top between ears of wheat on blue).
history: Arms and flag were approved together by the Ministry of the Interior on 7 July 2000 and registered as no. 211 in the roll of arms of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

features.role: Neverin arms — white tower on blue
